theorems.name: Submission.imrep_univ_smul_rescale_exists
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → ∃ R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R'.carrier = (fun x => c • x) ⁻¹' R.carrier ∧ (∀ x, R'.mult x = R.mult (c • x)) ∧ ∀ x, R'.orient x = R.orient (c • x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
